messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 10):
"""
5000/- per day shall be payable to the complainant. Such penalty is in addition to the penal interest liable to be paid by the Insurer under The Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017. The detailed provisions in respect of paras 4,5,7,12,17,18,19 and 20 above will be given in the Master Circular issued under IRDAI (Protection of Policyholders’ Interests, Operations and Allied Matters of Insurers) Regulations, 2024. Chapter II: Broad Requirements to be complied with by the Insurer in Health Insurance Business A. General Principles All Insurers shall ensure the following Principles while conducting Health Insurance Business: I. All the Insurers shall: - (1) Have in place board approved underwriting policy: - a. Covering its approach and aspects relating to offering health insurance coverage across all ages and medical conditions in line with Para 1 of Chapter I. b.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What penalty amount is payable to a complainant for non‑compliance with the IRDAI regulations?","answer":"A penalty of ₹5,000 per day shall be payable to the complainant.","facts":["5000/- per day shall be payable to the complainant","Such penalty is in addition to the penal interest liable to be paid by the Insurer"]},{"question":"Which paragraph numbers will be detailed in the upcoming Master Circular under the IRDAI Regulations 2024?","answer":"Paras 4, 5, 7, 12, 17, 18, 19 and 20 will be detailed in the forthcoming Master Circular.","facts":["paras 4,5,7,12,17,18,19 and 20 above will be given in the Master Circular"]}]}
